title: Sort an Array
description:
Given an array of integers `nums`, sort the array in ascending order and return it.

You must solve the problem **without using any built-in sorting functions** in `O(n log n)` worst-case time complexity and with minimal extra space.
hints: A naive Quick Sort degrades to O(n^2) on already-sorted or duplicate-heavy inputs unless carefully randomized and 3-way partitioned.
Merge Sort divides the array into two halves, recursively sorts each half, and merges the two sorted halves in O(n) time, guaranteeing O(n log n) worst-case performance.
Pre-allocate a single temporary buffer of length n and reuse it across merge calls to avoid repeated allocations.

examples.explanation: Duplicate values are preserved in sorted order: [0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 5].
Negative values precede zero and positive values in ascending order.
